failures.title: All nine generic admin content update operations return HTTP 500
failures.endpoint: PUT generic admin content update endpoints
failures.expected: A valid update persists and is reflected by admin and public reads.
failures.actual: Every generic update returned INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR on fresh run-owned records. Draft news could not be published and remained absent publicly.
failures.probable_cause: AdminContentService.update flushes a TimestampMixin entity and returns it without refreshing. SQLAlchemy expires server-updated updated_at; synchronous Pydantic serialization in the async request likely triggers MissingGreenlet. BlogService.update refreshes and succeeds.
failures.recommended_fix: Refresh the updated entity after flush, or eagerly obtain server defaults, before response serialization.
failures.regression_test: For each generic family: create, PUT, admin-read, verify public projection where published, then archive.

failures.title: Public registration PATCH returns HTTP 500 for every valid field
failures.expected: Valid draft-authorized fields persist and are returned.
failures.actual: The combined update and ten isolated field updates all returned INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; follow-up GET confirmed no value persisted.
failures.probable_cause: RegistrationService.patch flushes an entity whose on-update timestamp becomes expired, then public serialization accesses updated_at without refresh.
failures.recommended_fix: Refresh the registration after flush before building the public response.
failures.regression_test: PATCH each field individually and combined; assert 200, persistence, unchanged unrelated fields, and valid updated_at.

failures.title: Completing a media upload before object upload returns HTTP 500
failures.expected: Missing object is rejected as a bounded 4xx state error.
failures.actual: Both completion-before-upload cases returned INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; valid upload and completion succeeded.
failures.probable_cause: The storage HEAD/inspect call raises provider NoSuchKey/ClientError that is not translated into an application error.
failures.recommended_fix: Catch missing-object provider errors and return a documented 409 or 422.
failures.regression_test: Complete before upload and assert documented 4xx, then upload and complete the same lifecycle.

failures.title: Public media redirects to an unusable signed object URL
failures.expected: Redirect URL returns the uploaded bytes.
failures.actual: API returned 307, but following the freshly generated storage URL returned SignatureDoesNotMatch. Storage POST and completion worked.
failures.probable_cause: The configured public S3 endpoint/proxy changes the host or path used by URL signing, so the gateway validates a different canonical request.
failures.likely_component: S3 public endpoint configuration and media presigning adapter
failures.recommended_fix: Generate URLs against the externally reachable endpoint with the signature mode/canonical host accepted by the gateway.
failures.regression_test: Upload deterministic bytes, complete, follow untouched redirect, and compare SHA-256 and Content-Type.

failures.title: Unknown Host receives an empty HTTP 200 from the edge proxy
failures.expected: Edge or tenant resolver rejects unknown host with non-2xx.
failures.actual: Repeated requests returned an empty Caddy 200 with no tenant data or application headers, showing interception before FastAPI.
failures.probable_cause: The Caddy listener/default virtual host emits an empty success response for unmatched hosts.
failures.recommended_fix: Add a default virtual host returning 404/421, or forward unknown hosts to tenant resolution.
failures.regression_test: Send TLS requests to the authorized address with unknown Host and require non-2xx/no tenant content.

failures.title: OpenAPI omits runtime errors and misdocuments CSV media type
failures.endpoint: Authentication, admin, validation/not-found, callbacks, registration, media, and CSV
failures.expected: Observable statuses, error bodies, and media types are represented in OpenAPI.
failures.actual: 114 live undocumented-status observations plus one CSV mismatch affect 64 operations.
failures.probable_cause: Routes omit reusable application-error response declarations; CSV export omits text/csv schema metadata.
failures.likely_component: FastAPI route response declarations and admin CSV route
failures.recommended_fix: Register ErrorBody responses and explicitly declare text/csv for export.
failures.regression_test: Generate OpenAPI in CI and compare all intentional runtime status/media-type combinations.
